title.from: Pilobol.us P3-13: production reader cutover to the CMS-built path with parity gate, 7-day soak, instant Git rollback
title.to: Pilobol.us P3-09: move domains to the new apps, retire old apps/stack/empty backend/PAT, docs and procedures

description.from:
## Goal
Cut the production reader (pilobol.us, app d1od6t7lzbwanr, branch main) over to the CMS-built path with NO byte of the live site changing, then soak with the Git path kept as an instant rollback.

## Context (FACT, plan decisions D7, D8)
- DNS and domains do not change: pilobol.us and www stay on d1od6t7lzbwanr.
- After the reader-switch ticket, the reader app spec supports both paths by env: PILOBOL_SOURCE=cms selects the CMS export, unset selects Git (unchanged). The in-build parity gate (PILOBOL_PARITY_LIVE_URL) makes a non-identical build FAIL, which leaves the live deployment untouched.
- Branch env on main is currently empty (verified), so aws amplify update-branch --environment-variables replaces nothing important; always send the full map.
- Narration: every article page embeds the Auritus widget; the narration job hash covers text, voice and backend; HTML byte-identity implies zero text drift. Auritus v0.27.2: a wrong voice now fails loudly instead of substituting.
- Git content stays frozen at the cutover commit; the rollback to the Git path publishes that frozen content, so articles published in the CMS after cutover are NOT in Git unless snapshot-exported first.

## Exact steps
1. Preconditions: production import (parity proven), reader switch, staging and rebuild proofs all accepted; Ryan go/no-go in chat; no publish planned in the window (desk automation is board-only already).
2. Tag the Git state: git tag pre-cms-cutover on Pilobol.us main (Ryan yes) and record the commit and the last good job id (196 or later).
3. Backend config: change reader.branchName from cms-reader to main in papyrus.config.ts; merge; CMS main build redeploys the config (LIVE, Ryan yes). Verify the Lambda role policy now names branches/main.
4. LIVE (Ryan yes): aws amplify update-branch --app-id d1od6t7lzbwanr --branch-name main --environment-variables PILOBOL_SOURCE=cms,PILOBOL_PARITY_LIVE_URL=https://pilobol.us,PAPYRUS_GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT=...,PAPYRUS_IDENTITY_POOL_ID=...,PAPYRUS_MEDIA_BUCKET=...,AWS_REGION=us-east-1; then aws amplify start-job --app-id d1od6t7lzbwanr --branch-name main --job-type RELEASE. The job either passes the gate and deploys identical bytes, or fails and nothing changes.
5. After SUCCEED: verify-parity.py --dist <scratch Git build of the tagged commit> --live https://pilobol.us --narration = 94/94 and 11/11; open 3 article pages in a browser (Ryan); curl -I for cache-control headers; check one image URL.
6. LIVE (Ryan yes): update-branch again WITHOUT PILOBOL_PARITY_LIVE_URL (the gate is for the first build only); keep PILOBOL_SOURCE=cms. Run papyrus content rebuild --reader --app-id d1od6t7lzbwanr once: a second no-op build proves the production StartJob path.
7. Soak (7 days, D7): daily check of the job list for main; first real article is published through the newsroom (human publish) and its rebuild observed. Git web/content is not edited.

## Acceptance checks
- Parity gate build SUCCEED; live == Git baseline 94/94; narration 11/11; later rebuild-on-publish job on main SUCCEED after the first real publish.

## Rollback (seconds)
R1: aws amplify update-branch --app-id d1od6t7lzbwanr --branch-name main --environment-variables (the empty map) then start-job: the Git path rebuilds the frozen Git content. If new articles were published in the CMS meanwhile: papyrus content export-published --out <scratch> first, commit those files into web/content on a feature branch, merge, then do R1 (so no article disappears). R2: Amplify console "Redeploy this version" of the last Git-built job. DNS never changed.

## Risks
- The only moment the live site can change is step 4 and it is fenced by the parity gate. A CMS outage during any later build fails the build and keeps the old deployment (fail-closed).
- A deploy that is accepted but wrong in a way bytes cannot show (cache headers, 404 behavior) is covered by step 5 checks.

## Needs Ryan
Go/no-go; yes for steps 2, 3, 4, 6; the browser check in step 5.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
description.to:
## Goal
Finish the cutover: move the domains to the new apps, retire the old apps, old stack, old empty backend and the PAT secret, and update docs and procedures so the desk publishes through the CMS.

## Context (FACT, 2026-10-06)
- Old CMS app d11eu9hbs2mipk (stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, domain newsroom.pilobol.us), old reader d1od6t7lzbwanr (domains pilobol.us and www, hand-made, env var NAME ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, never print its value). Old backend: nested Amplify stacks amplify-d11eu9hbs2mipk-main-branch-... (empty; Cognito domain prefix papyrus-pilobol-us). Secret amplify/github-app-token (PAT) has no other user (only one app-shell stack exists; re-check).
- Hosted zone Z09961547QX1VHIXOBD7 is in this account. Brief downtime is accepted (pre-production). DNS does not change at the registrar; the Amplify domain associations move. The Auritus origin stays pilobol.us.
- Narration: article text is unchanged (importer verbatim), origin unchanged, so the 11 narrations keep working; spot check one.

## Exact steps
1. Ryan (or on his yes): delete the domain associations from the old apps (aws amplify delete-domain-association), then delete the old CMS stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us and the old backend stacks (empty) and the old apps. If the new backend used a temporary Cognito prefix, nothing else to do (or switch to papyrus-pilobol-us with one backend deploy).
2. Update infra/site.json with domains (newsroom.pilobol.us, staging.pilobol.us, pilobol.us) and the OAuth redirect URLs; Ryan yes to the stack update; wait for certificates. Add www as a second subdomain on the reader if the template supports it (otherwise note it).
3. Verify: https://pilobol.us and www serve the site, one article page in a browser with the narration player working, https://newsroom.pilobol.us/newsroom loads, https://staging.pilobol.us gates anonymous users, robots.txt on production allows.
4. Cleanup (Ryan yes): delete secret amplify/github-app-token (recovery window); decide the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY var (goes with the old reader app).
5. Docs: rewrite Pilobol.us AGENTS.md (deployment via Amplify GitHub App; build via reader/build.py; publishing = human Publish in /newsroom; automation stays board-only), README, skills text that tells agents to commit under web/content; Papyrus PR: delete publications/pilobol_us and publications/pilobolus, the brand import in repo-root papyrus.config.ts, PILOBOL_US_THEME_PACK_TOKENS; replace bootstrap.md with a pointer to docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md; update docs/site-hosting.md and standard-site 3.3. Update /Users/home/Projects/Pilobolus/site.yml (local file).

## Acceptance checks
Domains answer from the new apps; old apps and stacks gone; Papyrus CI green after the core cleanup; grep shows no Pilobol.us brand logic in src or lib outside tests and docs.

## Rollback
Git history and the tag pre-cms-cutover; the old resources are gone by design.

## Risks
Certificate validation wait; a domain cannot be on two apps (delete first).

## Needs Ryan
Step 1 deletions, step 2 yes, step 4 secret deletion.

## Common rules (Phase 3 Pilobol.us, simplified plan v2)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (PR AnthusAI/Papyrus#128). Ryan 2026-10-06: Pilobol.us is PRE-PRODUCTION, Git history is the rollback, HARD CUTOVER: no soak, no Git freeze, no dual Git/CMS build path, no parity gate, brief downtime is fine. New Amplify apps are created from the template; the old apps and the old EMPTY backend are retired at the end.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan (or on his explicit yes).
- Never build in /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us (its build rewrites content): use a fresh clone or a worktree.
- Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo: feature branch + PR, never push to its main. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus only run kbs.
- Keep article text verbatim (the importer already does; narration hashes depend on it). The Auritus embed is origin-locked to the site key's origin; the production origin stays pilobol.us, so nothing changes there (narration will not play on temporary amplifyapp.com URLs: expected).
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.
